bullets: Premium session users on free tiers can once again start up to 5 paid chat sessions per day instead of the reduced 4 limit.
Freebucks ceiling raised so daily usage limit is now 4x of Freebucks value instead of 3x.
Limited tier leads with GLM 5.3 Flash as its hero model while DeepSeek V4 Flash stays the always-joinable option.
The Freebuff session now shows a pending-refund notice and the final returned amount when an end-of-session refund lands.
Limited tier plan-only model gate now keeps Luna gated only at the limited tier while leaving it in the full-access premium pool.
CLI model picker shows a peak-freebucks pricing badge on expensive model rows with a tooltip naming the costly window and its end.
The free-tier turn spent limit message no longer speculates an assistant got stuck in a loop, it states the turn reached its limit.
Earn Freebucks page link text now reads 'engage with a promoted post' instead of the old 'level up' wording.
Advertiser assistant use of a new MCP tool on your behalf is now tracked by which account and tool, success or fail, and duration.
